issues.description: The solution aliases the primary key column `id` to `Kennung` (SELECT id AS Kennung) in aufgabe01.sql, while the problem statement asks for the ID and explicitly instructs not to rename columns with AS unless requested. The template starts with SELECT * FROM Schwimmbad, so students expect the column to be `id`/`ID`. This alias introduces an unexpected identifier (`Kennung`) for the same conceptual entity (the Schwimmbad ID) and conflicts with the stated instructions, creating mapping confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the alias and use the original column name `id` in the solution (e.g. SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad') so it matches the problem wording and the template; or, if an alias is desired, update the problem statement to explicitly allow/require the alias `Kennung`.
